description: This file contains custom Flutter widget classes that provide UI helpers for a food delivery application. It defines three main components: GlassCard, AnimatedTap, and FoodImage, each enhancing the visual appeal and interactivity of the app.

classes.name: GlassCard
classes.description: A rounded, semi-transparent, glassmorphic container with shadows, suitable for main surfaces to give a premium look.

classes.name: AnimatedTap
classes.description: A widget that adds a scale animation response to tap gestures, useful for buttons and tappable cards.

classes.name: FoodImage
classes.description: A widget that displays network images with a fixed aspect ratio and rounded corners, including loading placeholders and error handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each custom widget, rendering the UI components with specified decorations, animations, and image loading behaviors.

methods.name: _setDown
methods.description: Internal method to update the tap state and trigger the scale animation.
